subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu direct-message continuity be fixed with TTL-aware direct-session retention plus Feishu `open_id` validation/doctor repair, or should the project require `per-account-channel-peer` as the supported multi-account mode first?
rationale: The fix touches durable session retention, channel identity validation, and possible history repair; automation can identify the gap but cannot safely choose the compatibility and store-growth tradeoff.

options.title: TTL-aware retention plus Feishu repair
options.body: Protect active or recent direct sessions, reject or repair malformed Feishu direct peer IDs, and add a doctor/migration path for existing malformed rows.

options.title: Document account-scoped mode first
options.body: Treat `per-account-channel-peer` as the required multi-account Feishu workaround now and defer direct-session retention and malformed-key repair to narrower follow-up work.

options.title: Wait for live fixture
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a sanitized sessions store or live Feishu replay before choosing the permanent retention and validation behavior.

recommendation.title: TTL-aware retention plus Feishu repair
recommendation.body: Protect active or recent direct sessions, reject or repair malformed Feishu direct peer IDs, and add a doctor/migration path for existing malformed rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses core session maintenance and config compatibility policy, and their history is strongest on that surface.
